title: Battle of Bapaume (1871)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Bapaume (1871)", at revision 1370433317, opens: "The Battle of Bapaume took place during the Franco-Prussian War, brought about by French attempts to relieve the besieged city of Péronne, Somme. The battle was fought on 3 January 1871 near the town of Bapaume." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q641125, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1871 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
